questions.text: What NBA rule most needs to change?
questions.original: What rule (regarding play, schedule, Draft/Lottery, playoff format, roster construction, etc.) most needs to change?

answers.t: Roster construction – Apron rules too harsh, Add a cap discount for own drafted players, Allow trading partial salaries, Make all minimum contracts the same
Draft schedule – Back to one day, Only Lottery on Day 1, After Free agency
Game flow – Continuous/faster review, Hockey-style subs, No live-ball timeouts
Playoff format – Seed 1-16, Top seeds choose opponents, Change Play-In format
Draft system – Can’t draft in top six in three straight years, Shouldn’t reward losing
Schedule – Fewer back-to-backs, No home-road back-to-backs
